content.comment_body: I have two [product_name] units ([article_no]) running firmware [version_no], and I'm using [product_name] version [version_no]. I installed the same program on both; one works perfectly, but the other only registers input on one terminal (I8). I've deleted and reinstalled the program, performed a factory reset, and checked the wiring which is identical on both units, but the issue persists. What additional steps can I try?
Hello [user_name], Review the display on the [product_name] to confirm if the input activates when voltage is applied to the terminals. If not, the unit may be defective. Best regards, [user_name]
